packageRules.description: Stay on the PostgreSQL 16 branch used by upstream bigbluebutton/docker (postgres:16-alpine): a major bump needs the pgdata volume path and greenlight/graphql schema compat reviewed first

Docker versioning only considers a candidate tag when it has the same number of version parts as the current one, and it ranks a shorter tag as newer, so v3.8.2 never sees v3.8.2.4. Loose versioning compares part by part instead. allowedVersions keeps the flavour tags out, since loose ignores the suffix that docker versioning used to filter on.

These three tags carry a compatibility suffix that docker versioning requires to stay byte-identical, so no upgrade is ever offered. Loose versioning compares the suffix instead of demanding equality; allowedVersions pins the tag shape, because loose alone would happily walk back to an unrelated tag scheme (freeswitch v2.7.0) or read a date tag as a version.
Mixing BigBlueButton component versions is not supported upstream, so the whole alangecker set must move in a single PR
